name: Waitlist: Split
summary: A split landing section with an announcement badge, headline, email request form, overlapping member avatars with a count, and a gradient panel holding a mock form card.
useWhen: Collecting emails for an early-access or waitlist launch on a landing page
Showing social proof next to a signup field, with the panel stacked below on phones
avoidWhen: The product is open to sign-up already; use a sign-up form, since a waitlist adds a step
A long pricing or feature page needs more than one call to action; use a pricing or feature section instead
